explanation: The Almighty Creator who, according to Genesis, created the heavens, the earth, and all life.
The activity of accumulating material goods on an earthly basis instead of focusing on the eternal.
The inner person where thoughts, will, and faith have their seat, determining our actions.
The feeling of anxiety about loss or punishment from people, as opposed to the fear of God's righteousness.
The act of refraining from demanding retribution for a sin when it has been acknowledged and repented of.
The ritual with water that symbolizes cleansing, repentance, and entry into God's kingdom.
The concept of wisdom to prioritize the eternal over the temporary through faith in Jesus.
